scope.policy_input: Only public A, chart geometry and past public outcomes

remaining_proof_obligations: Independent external review of the physical adaptive affine measurement grammar
A polynomial-time policy family with non-negligible performance on a growing native source

Useful descended-label distribution, recursion and paid inter-level composition
Matched classical attacks and hard natural-problem reduction
falsifiers: Static comparator cannot use all public labels and initial syndrome
